name: kopia
title: Kopia
description: Kopia makes fast, encrypted, deduplicated backups to a local folder, S3, B2, SFTP or a cloud drive, with a web UI for snapshots and restores. Open the UI (login below), create or connect a repository — /repository is the mounted backup folder — and snapshot /data, which is the source folder you choose here.

variables.name: KOPIA_REPO_PASSWORD
variables.label: Repository password
variables.description: Encrypts the backups — losing it means losing the backups

variables.name: KOPIA_REPOSITORY_PATH
variables.label: Local repository folder
variables.description: Host directory mounted at /repository (use it for a filesystem repository, or pick S3/B2/SFTP in the UI)
